_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Hana Yoshida
about_me: I'm Hana, an industrial design senior building accessible playground equipment. I need families who use wheelchairs to test prototypes and a manufacturer for small runs.
goals: Test the playground prototype with five families

debriefs.text: Emma Larsson, an HCI master's student, is recruiting wheelchair users too and offered to share contacts.
Tariq Mahmoud at the Kerrytown makerspace said I can use the CNC router on weekends.
Hannah Brooks, city planner, mentioned Ann Arbor is rebuilding two playgrounds next year.
Derek Olsen, patent attorney, gave me a free consult on design patents.
